article_title: Australian state to begin gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: New South Wales will begin a gun buyback as part of reforms introduced after the Bondi Beach attack
Australia has removed every restriction on gun ownership
New South Wales will give free firearms to licensed owners
The Bondi Beach attack led to changes in beach safety rules
tasks.correct_answer: New South Wales will begin a gun buyback as part of reforms introduced after the Bondi Beach attack
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בתוכנית רכישת הנשק בחזרה בניו סאות' ויילס, כחלק מרפורמות שנקבעו לאחר הפיגוע בבונדי ביץ'.

tasks.prompt: When is the first phase of the New South Wales buyback due to begin?
options: Immediately after the announcement
On 2 November 2026
At the end of 2027
On the anniversary of the 1996 Port Arthur attack
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השלב הראשון של התוכנית אמור להתחיל ב־2 בנובמבר 2026.

tasks.prompt: What does “eligible” mean when the article refers to eligible firearms?
options: Already destroyed by police
Manufactured outside Australia
Meeting the conditions for the scheme
Owned without any licence
tasks.correct_answer: Meeting the conditions for the scheme
tasks.explanation_hebrew: eligible פירושו עומד בתנאים שנקבעו להשתתפות בתוכנית או לקבלת פיצוי.

tasks.prompt: What will owners receive for firearms accepted by the scheme?
options: A new gun licence lasting ten years
A replacement weapon of the same type
Free ammunition from the state
Financial compensation when they surrender the firearms
tasks.correct_answer: Financial compensation when they surrender the firearms
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בעלי הנשק הזכאים יקבלו פיצוי כספי כאשר ימסרו את כלי הירייה במסגרת התוכנית.

tasks.prompt: Why is the buyback being introduced in phases?
options: Common firearms can follow a fixed schedule first, while higher-value cases need a later valuation process
The government plans to return all surrendered guns after phase one
Only people living outside New South Wales can join phase two
Each firearm must remain with its owner for several years
tasks.correct_answer: Common firearms can follow a fixed schedule first, while higher-value cases need a later valuation process
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השלב הראשון משתמש במחירים קבועים לכלי נשק נפוצים, ואילו כלי נשק יקרים יותר דורשים מסלול הערכה ופיצוי נפרד.

tasks.prompt: What does “sweeping reforms” mean in the article?
options: Small temporary changes
Wide-ranging changes affecting many parts of the system
Rules applying only to one gun dealer
Payments made with no legal changes
tasks.correct_answer: Wide-ranging changes affecting many parts of the system
tasks.explanation_hebrew: sweeping מתאר שינויים מקיפים ורחבי היקף, ולא תיקון קטן או נקודתי.

tasks.prompt: Give three features of the New South Wales gun buyback or the related firearm reforms.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מדויקים על הזכאות, הפיצוי, השלבים או מגבלות הבעלות.
expected_points: Phase one begins on 2 November 2026
Eligible owners will be compensated for surrendered firearms
Phase one uses fixed payments for common types of firearms
Phase two will cover eligible higher-value firearms
Compensation for a higher-value firearm is capped at A$10,000
The reforms limit the number and types of firearms an individual may own
Licence periods are reduced from five years to two

tasks.prompt: Summarise why the scheme was introduced, how it will operate and what the government hopes it will achieve.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את הפיגוע בבונדי, מסירת כלי הנשק תמורת פיצוי, יישום בשלבים ומטרת הבטיחות.
expected_points: The scheme follows the deadly Bondi Beach attack of December 2025
New South Wales tightened its firearm laws after the attack
Owners affected by new limits or classifications can surrender eligible firearms
The programme will pay compensation in two phases
The authorities want surrendered weapons safely destroyed and firearm risk reduced

tasks.prompt: Why does the scheme include support for gun dealers and other affected businesses?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד שינויי החוק ותוכנית הרכישה עלולים להשפיע כלכלית על עסקים ומדוע נדרש סיוע בתקופת המעבר.
expected_points: Dealers may hold stock affected by the new rules
Lower permitted ownership can reduce sales and demand
Businesses need time and advice to adjust to the reforms
Grants and licence-fee relief can reduce transition costs
Support may improve practical compliance with the programme

tasks.prompt: Using the article, explain two possible benefits and one possible concern about a large gun buyback.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג שני יתרונות וחשש אחד, ולבסס אותם על פרטי הכתבה בלי לחרוג לטענות שאינן נתמכות.
expected_points: It can remove firearms that exceed new legal limits
Surrendered weapons can be safely destroyed
Compensation can encourage licensed owners to comply
The scheme may strengthen public safety after a deadly attack
A concern is the cost of compensation and administration
Some lawful owners or businesses may feel unfairly affected
